summary: Ansible pushes modules to nodes (over SSH by default), runs them to reach a desired state, and removes them, needing no servers, daemons or databases; custom modules can be written in any language that returns JSON.
questions: How does Ansible run tasks on remote machines?
Does Ansible leave anything installed on managed nodes?
What languages can I use to write custom modules?

answer_card.title: How modules work in Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible connects to nodes and pushes small programs (modules) that describe desired state, runs them (SSH by default), then removes them. No servers, daemons or databases required. Custom modules can be written in any language that returns JSON.
